Puts the scoreboard and the logo over the picture now, whatever is found on the channel: the channel\'s own game, one of today\'s you pick, or the logo alone (top right until the channel\'s logo is found). It stays up until you switch it off (12 hours at most).

Just for %1$s: Always up puts the scoreboard and logo up whenever it plays, Never keeps them off it. Its logo, style, picture tag, see-through and size are kept for it as you set them here or in Move and resize.

Back to the built-in films, here and on the TVs

Plays 4 minutes before kick-off on the phone and the TVs, with the channel\'s sound off until it ends: the competition\'s own film (Premier League, LaLiga, Champions League and the rest; plain football\'s with the Champions League-style ball when there\'s no competition), ending on Whitebrook Road Sports and the fixture. F1, UFC and boxing get theirs as the race or fight night begins.
Your video plays in place of the built-in film, without its sound, then the Whitebrook Road Sports ending with its music: trim it first to the part you want (40 seconds at most is used).
